headline: Support for Households and Businesses – Who Will Be the Winners from Kyriakos Mitsotakis's This Year's Announcements at the Thessaloniki International Fair
summary: Freelancers, pensioners, salaried employees and new families are expected to be central to the government's support package announced at the Thessaloniki International Fair. The stated goal is to reduce taxes.
why: Greece's annual budget and tax measures shape domestic consumption, public finances and the outlook for Greek government bonds. The Thessaloniki fair is the venue where the prime minister usually outlines the next package.
